variants.text: There is a robot hand. Block b is on block a. Block a is on the table. Block b is clear. The hand is empty. A block on the table is supported.

support.compile: unsupported for the mixed variants; supported for the controls

explain: The check is syntactic and conservative: any rule whose antecedent contains a fluent (directly or through a computed property) and whose consequent contains a static predicate (isa, connected) is rejected. The two controls pin the boundary so the check does not over-reject. The fluent_to_fluent Q2 also pins the snapshot view: a static-looking question about b cannot be answered through a hypothetical placement.
